reason: 一次資料の要旨・本文が示す対象はLLM推論システムの計算量、メモリ、レイテンシ、スループット、KV cache、量子化、offload、servingの改善と技術的につながらない。CLIP-DPO applies preference optimization to improve visual-language model hallucination behavior. The contribution is training-time alignment and evaluation on hallucination benchmarks; no inference efficiency or offload method is presented.
title: CLIP-DPO: Vision-Language Models as a Source of Preference for Fixing Hallucinations in LVLMs
